audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads Skill/Singed/Singed/Skill/Skill/Singed/Singed — four Singed rows and zero Gangplank rows on a 47.18% matchup over 1772 games, and the page's own prose says 'this lane belongs to Gangplank once he hits two items' and 'accept that the 1v1 is lost'.
audit.why: A losing matchup cannot have the loser winning four of seven stages. The packet chart agrees.
audit.corrected: Skill / Singed / Gangplank / Gangplank / Skill / Gangplank / Gangplank, with ratings dropped to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: First-item and two-item rows credit Singed's Rylai's spike; the actual spike that decides the lane is Gangplank's Sheen.
audit.why: The content layer already says Sheen turns Parrrley into burst that outpaces Singed's regen — the full layer's phase text contradicts it.
audit.corrected: First item = Sheen on Parrrley; two items = crit plus a global Cannon Barrage (160/140/120s).

audit.whatIsWrong: Three ability facts are wrong or missing: Parrrley is called 'a slow-moving skillshot' that 'crits through minions'; Mega Adhesive is said to 'root on exit'; and Remove Scurvy is said to cleanse a 'Fling slow'.
audit.why: Riot: Parrrley 'Shoots target' — a targeted 625-range shot on 4.5s, so it cannot be minion-blocked and is not dodgeable. Mega Adhesive only slows and grounds; the root requires a Fling landing inside it. Fling is a knockup and applies no slow. Remove Scurvy (22/20/18/16/14s) cures crowd control and heals — the root is what it eats, and that is the real reason the goo combo fails here.
audit.corrected: Parrrley targeted 625 range 4.5s; glue slows and grounds, Fling-into-glue roots; Remove Scurvy 22s at rank 1 is the cooldown to play around.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block names Powder Kegs, which has no meaningful cooldown to track, and gives no numbers at all.
audit.why: Remove Scurvy is the punishable cooldown in this lane and it is 22s at rank 1, 14s at rank 5.
audit.corrected: Track Remove Scurvy, not the kegs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rated EVEN at 6/10 on a 47.18% matchup with a 9.5/10 carry threat.
audit.why: The difficulty band used elsewhere in this file for a losing lane is TRICKY / 7.5 / #ff8b3d.
audit.corrected: diff TRICKY, tone #ff8b3d, diffRating 7.5/10, with the difficulty and final-rating lines following.

edits.before: Level 1 is a coin flip of poke vs approach — Gangplank's Parrrley (Q) is a slow-moving skillshot but it crits through minions and he can start placing barrels before you get near him. Don't run straight at a lit barrel; walk onto it yourself to detonate it harmlessly and deny him the gold and the chain. Level 2 is your one genuine threat window: Fling comes online before he hits Sheen, so you can actually close the gap and force him to waste his first Remove Scurvy (W) to cleanse your Fling slow rather than saving it for a real all-in. By level 3 Mega Adhesive roots on exit, which sounds powerful — but he W-cleanses it instantly on zero counterplay, so your goo is wasted unless his W is already down from earlier.
edits.after: Level 1 is poke versus approach — Parrrley (Q) is a targeted 625-range shot on a 4.5-second cooldown, not a skillshot, so minions will not body-block it and only distance keeps you safe. Don't run at a lit barrel; walk onto it yourself to detonate it harmlessly and deny him both the gold and the chain. Level 2 is your one genuine threat window: Fling comes online before he hits Sheen, so you can close the gap and force him to spend Remove Scurvy (W) — 22 seconds at rank 1 — on your goo rather than banking it for a real all-in. By level 3 Mega Adhesive slows and grounds, and a Fling that drops him inside it roots him, which sounds powerful — but he W-cleanses that root instantly, so the goo is only worth throwing once his W is already down.

notes: Level chart flipped as one atomic group across both layers to match the 47.18% win rate. Three fabricated mechanics removed: Parrrley described as a slow-moving skillshot that crits through minions (it is a targeted 625-range shot), Mega Adhesive described as rooting on exit (it slows and grounds; the root needs a Fling landing inside it), and Remove Scurvy described as cleansing a 'Fling slow' (Fling is a knockup with no slow). UNVERIFIED and left alone: whether Remove Scurvy can be used mid-knockup to land before the Fling resolves, and whether it removes the grounded state as well as the root — needsResearch is empty in both kits. Also left alone: the kit's trueDamage flag on Cannon Barrage, which Riot's own description does not support, so no true-damage claim was written.
